deploy-bot: Scheduling config-only deploy in change window 02:00-02:30 UTC. Changes: default_rps 500->360, timeout 18000ms->14000ms, batching.max_tokens 2000->1000, routing add 'latency-first' for eu-west, kv_ttl 600->320s. Canary: 1% 10m -> 8% 12m -> 40% 8m -> 100%. Rollback: 5xx +0.5% OR p95 +2s OR evictions +20%.

deploy-bot: Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-config-1742800000

nina: ACK. I'll watch p95/p99 and redis evictions. Lower kv_ttl likely to increase write load.

chris: pinning traffic to model-serving:v2.3.9 to avoid routing flips. Excluding heavy tenants: data-pipeline, metrics-export.

ops: exclusions applied. playbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/config-rollbacks

sre-oncall: setting alerts: p95>1s warn, p95>2s critical; 5xx>0.3% warn, 5xx>0.5% critical; kvcache_evictions > baseline+12% warn.

deploy-bot: Starting 1% canary now.

nina: 2m in: p95 410ms, 5xx 0.01%, evictions +3%.

deploy-bot: 1% complete. Promoting to 8%.

chris: confirmed model pin. keeping it for 24h.

sre-oncall: at 8% after 5m: evictions +10%, p95 +60ms. No criticals.

deploy-bot: rolling to 40%.

nina: ramp caused a short p95 blip to 1.1s for 80s then steady 620ms. Evictions settled ~11%.

ops: filing follow-up INC-700: 'kvcache-ttl-ops' for warmup and TTL tuning.

deploy-bot: completing 100% now. Rollout done.

nina: post-roll 5m: p95 640ms, 5xx 0.03%, evictions +12%, token_cost +1.5%.

chris: leaving pin; we'll unpin after smoke tomorrow.

sre-oncall: monitoring for 30m. No critical alerts.

ops: notes updated: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03/config-1742800000#notes

nina: no objections. closing thread.

deploy-bot: Thread closed.
